sessions.weather_text: Looks Dry but might have some damp spots, rained overnight. Rained part way through
sessions.notes: A little understeery on entry in dry, but decent in damp, would be too sketchy in full wet. Front left is underdamped, way more time in rebound. Front right is slightly underdamped. Rear looks good.

sessions.weather_text: Damp, lots of rain partway through
setup_changes: Stopped half way through to add air
sessions.notes: Felt good, lots of rain partway through, but decent balance, rear wanted to step out on puddles though. Stopped half way through to add air, balance came back.

sessions.weather_text: Damp, dried as the session went on
sessions.notes: Dried as the session went on. Tires over-pressured out of the window after a few laps. Lots of understeer mid corner, need to fix that. Probably stiffen rear one step (2/3). Turn in was good, exits were slightly understeering, but hard to tell if that was mid corner continuing.
